arguments.command:
python -c "
from glom import glom, T

# Test dynamic key evaluation - keys should be evaluated as specs
target = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
result = glom(target, {T['a']: T['b']})  # Key T['a'] evaluates to 1, value T['b'] evaluates to 2
print('Dynamic key result:', result)
assert result == {1: 2}, f'Expected {{1: 2}}, got {result}'

# Verify T['key'] still works for normal lookups
target2 = {'x': {'y': 1}}
result2 = glom(target2, {'a': T['x']['y']})
print('Normal lookup result:', result2)
assert result2 == {'a': 1}, f'Expected {{\"a\": 1}}, got {result2}'

print('All tests passed!')
"
